title: The Power of a Short Speech
text:
Public speeches are an important part of school life. A good speech has a clear beginning, a middle, and an end. The speaker should look at the audience and speak slowly so people can understand every word. Many students feel nervous before they speak in front of a group.

One way to feel less nervous is to practise the speech many times. Some people record themselves and listen to the recording to find mistakes. A short speech with a strong ending is often more memorable than a long one. Teachers say that confidence grows with each speech.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, what should a speaker do so that people understand every word?
According to paragraph two, what can some people do to find mistakes in their speech?
Why might a short speech with a strong ending be useful?
options: It avoids the need for any practice
Teachers will always give it a higher grade
Audiences are more likely to remember it
It lets the speaker skip the ending

questions.text: What is the writer's main point about confidence?
options: It stays the same no matter how often you speak
It comes mainly from natural talent
It improves through repeated practice in speaking
It is only important for teachers

paragraph_translations: Los discursos públicos son una parte importante de la vida escolar. Un buen discurso tiene un principio claro, una parte central y un final. El orador debe mirar al público y hablar despacio para que la gente entienda cada palabra. Muchos estudiantes se sienten nerviosos antes de hablar frente a un grupo.

Una forma de sentirse menos nervioso es practicar el discurso muchas veces. Algunas personas se graban y escuchan la grabación para encontrar errores. Un discurso corto con un final fuerte suele ser más memorable que uno largo. Los profesores dicen que la confianza crece con cada discurso.
